jobs.prompt: Create premium grayscale anatomical educational illustration for DUMBBELL STEP-UP (catalog0431), ADULT MALE. Reference artistic style ONLY, replace squat. THREE equal panels horizontally, generous white gutters, same model/box/camera/clothes/weights/scale. Full figures and box within panel boundaries. Side-front three-quarter camera showing both feet contact. One sturdy rectangular exercise box about knee height or slightly lower in FRONT of person, with nonslip top and stable base. ONE dumbbell EACH hand hangs at sides with neutral grip, arms straight throughout. Panel1 stand on floor directly in front of box, feet hip-width, face box. Panel2 RIGHT foot entirely planted on top of box, heel included; LEFT foot remains on floor behind body, right knee over toes, torso slightly inclined naturally. Panel3 stand tall with BOTH feet flat fully supported ON TOP OF SAME BOX, right leg extended and left foot brought up next to it; no floating feet or box through legs. Keep whole soles and realistic support/contact shadows visible, no jumping. Same right leading leg throughout. Red glute-region surface teaching overlay on seat/lateral hip of intact shorts only, other muscles grayscale. Exposed muscles detailed grayscale realistic proportions. Full opaque black sleeveless athletic top wrapping chest torso back sides; knee-length black shorts with full rear seat crotch front sides/back, seams folds closed hems, shoes. No transparent clothing or cutaways/missing rear panels. White background soft shadows. No text labels captions numbers arrows logos. Candidate poses for qualified movement review, not animation.
jobs.inspectionNote: Three step-up positions, stable box, whole lead foot/top stance contact and complete opaque garments visible. Qualified lead-side consistency, box height, balance and glute overlay boundary review pending.
